text: dehendriyeṣu niyatāḥ karma guṇāḥ kurvate svabhogārtham | nāhaṃ kartā na mameti jānataḥ karma naiva badhnāti ||
anyaśarīreṇa kṛtaṃ karma bhaved yena deha utpannaḥ | tad avaśyaṃ bhoktavyaṃ bhogād eva kṣayo 'sya nirdiṣṭaḥ ||
prāgjñānotpatticitaṃ yat karma jñānaśikhiśikhālīḍham | bījam iva dahanadagdhaṃ janmasamarthaṃ na tad bhavati ||
jñānotpatter ūrdhvaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ karma yat tad api nāma | na śliṣyati kartāraṃ puṣkarapattraṃ yathā vāri ||
vāgdehamānasair iha karmacayaḥ kriyata iti buddhāḥ prāhuḥ | eko 'pi nāham eṣāṃ kartā tatkarmaṇāṃ nāsmi ||
karmaphalabījanāśāj janmavināśo na cātra saṃdehaḥ | buddhvaivam apagatatamāḥ savitevābhāti bhārūpaḥ ||
yadvad iṣīkātūlaṃ pavanoddhūtaṃ hi daśa diśo yāti | brahmaṇi tattvajñānāt tathaiva karmāṇi tattvavidaḥ ||
kṣīrād uddhṛtam ājyaṃ kṣiptaṃ yadvan na pūrvavat tasmin | prakṛtiguṇebhyas tadvat pṛthakkṛtaś cetano nātmā ||
guṇamayamāyāgahanaṃ nirdhūya yathā tamaḥ sahasrāṃśuḥ | bāhyābhyantaracārī saindhavaghanavad bhavet puruṣaḥ ||
yadvad deho 'vayavā mṛd eva tasya vikārajātāni | tadvat sthāvarajaṅgamam advaitaṃ dvaitavad bhāti ||
ekasmāt kṣetrajñād bahvyaḥ kṣetrajñajātayo jātāḥ | lohagatād iva dahanāt samantato viṣphuliṅgagaṇāḥ ||
te guṇasaṃgamadoṣād baddhā iva dhānyajātayaḥ svatuṣaiḥ | janma labhante tāvad yāvan na jñānavahninā dagdhāḥ ||
triguṇā caitanyātmani sarvagate 'vasthite 'khilādhāre | kurute sṛṣṭim avidyā sarvatra spṛśyate tayā nātmā ||
rajjvāṃ bhujaṃgahetuḥ prabhavavināśau yathā na staḥ | jagadutpattivināśau na ca kāraṇam asti tadvad iha ||
janmavināśanagamanāgamamalasambandhavarjito nityam | ākāśa iva ghaṭādiṣu sarvātmā sarvadopetaḥ ||
karmaśubhāśubhaphalasukhaduḥkhair yogo bhavaty upādhīnām | tatsaṃsargād bandhas taskarasaṃgād ataskaravad ||
dehaguṇakaraṇagocarasaṃgāt puruṣasya yāvad iha bhāvaḥ | tāvan māyāpāśaiḥ saṃsāre baddha iva bhāti ||
